request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"I'm writing on behalf of the Korean Student Association about our Lunar New Year Festival, a shared festival with food, games and performances from both of our clubs. It is for the students in our two communities and the friends who come along to celebrate with them. We would be glad to have you co-host the event with us as a fellow recognized student organization. With both clubs behind the festival, students would get to enjoy food, games and performances from each community in a shared space, and the event would feel more welcoming to everyone who comes. Your help as a co-host would shape what the students experience.","contains_instructions":false}
